topic: NACA series, Vortex theory, Magnus effect, Kutta Jakubowski law, Span wise flow, down Wash wing tip and trailing edge vortices.
syllabus_extract: NACA series, Vortex theory, Magnus effect, Kutta Jakubowski law, Span wise flow, down Wash wing tip and trailing edge vortices. Methods for preventing span- wise flow.
specific_objectives: 6.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to describe various types of aerofoil sections, conditions of performance, theories, and concept related with performance

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Activity: Demonstration of spanwise flow using smoke or ribbon on wing model. Safety: Secure model firmly. Supervision: Instructor direct.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an aerofoil section?
Define lift in terms of pressure difference.
Recall the basic Bernoulli principle application.

development.content:
NACA series classification systems
Kutta Jakubowski circulation law
Vortex theory basics

Magnus effect principles
Spanwise flow mechanisms
Downwash generation

Wing tip vortices formation
Trailing edge vortices
Prevention methods for spanwise flow

summary_questions: Explain how the Kutta condition determines circulation.
Describe the cause of wing tip vortices.
home_assignment_question: How do wing tip vortices contribute to induced drag?

pft_rows.syllabus: Drag analysis, induced, parasite, form, skin friction, profile and total drag. D-V curve.
